title: RepoSuite AgentEvent v1
description: Canonical harness-neutral agent telemetry event envelope (reposuite.agent-event.v1). RepoSuite-level contract; intended to be emitted natively by RepoSuite Relay without semantic redesign. See docs/AGENT_EVENT_V1.md.

schema.description: Canonical schema identifier. Other values fail validation.

event_id.description: Idempotency authority, '{session_id}:{sequence}'. Replay reproduces the same id.

investigation_id.description: Logical investigation/task id; may span multiple sessions. NOT a synonym of session_id.

repo_head.description: Git commit the agent investigated (memory staleness anchor).

sequence.description: Monotonic order within the session; primary ordering authority.

timestamp.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC. For wall-time analysis, not ordering.

runtime.description: e.g. devin, codex, opencode. Consumers must not branch on it.

type.description: Event family. Known V1 families: session_started, session_completed, model_call_started, model_call_completed, tool_call_started, tool_call_completed, source_observed, context_artifact_presented, agent_message, final_answer, task_outcome. Unknown future types are preserved verbatim (forward-compat).

data.description: Typed payload; opaque for unknown types.

content_digest.description: sha256 of canonical semantic content (event minus content_digest); conflict detection for a repeated event_id.
